page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance configured for balanced compute and memory performance. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on x86_64 architecture, this instance operates on a KVM hypervisor. It delivers 24 dedicated vCPUs with dedicated CPU allocation, ensuring consistent processing capacity across multi-threaded operations.

The memory allocation totals 96.0 GB, providing a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The instance includes no bundled local disk storage, relying on external cloud block storage for persistent operating system and application data. Network performance is backed by an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth. There are no discrete GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses included in this configuration.

With its 1:4 hardware balance, ecs.g6.6xlarge offers resource density tailored for non-specialized enterprise infrastructure. The lack of local NVMe storage and dedicated GPU hardware positions this instance for workloads requiring standard network capability and consistent processing capabilities without hardware-accelerated overhead. Key application fits include mid-tier web application serving, microservices orchestrators, enterprise resource planning deployments, build servers, and general-purpose database instances.
